dataset: National Heritage List for England (NHLE) - Listed Building polygons, FeatureServer layer 3
evidence_slice: Historic England Open Data Hub service item 767f279327a24845bf47dfe5eae9862b publishes layer 3, Listed Building polygons, as an official public no-login esriGeometryPolygon feature layer. The layer supports GeoJSON and exposes ListEntry, Name, Grade, ListDate, AmendDate, CaptureScale, hyperlink, area_ha, NGR, Easting and Northing fields under OGL. The selected new Exeter centroid attribute window requests at most 50 features with geometry, but its response payload was inaccessible through the available retrieval channel; no feature attributes or polygon coordinates were read.

field_evidence.footprint: Official layer 3 is esriGeometryPolygon and metadata states listed-building polygons/area are published where building footprint has been mapped, but the selected query returned no retrievable feature payload or coordinates.
field_evidence.type_use: Official layer schema exposes Name together with ListEntry/Grade on each polygon feature, but no feature row was retrievable in this source window.
field_evidence.heritage: Historic England Open Data Hub identifies the NHLE service and layer 3 as Listed Building polygons, released under OGL.
